test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The selling price of 20 books is equal to the cost price of 6 books. Find the loss or gain percentage.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the **Cost Price (CP)** of 1 book be 1 unit and **Selling Price (SP)** of 1 book be x units.

According to the question: 20 × SP = 6 × CP.

Ratio of SP to CP: SP/CP = 6/20 = 3/10.

Loss = CP − SP = 10 − 3 = 7 units.

Loss % = (Loss ÷ CP) × 100 = (7 ÷ 10) × 100 = 70%.

**∴ The correct answer is 70% loss.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** SP of 20 books = CP of 6 books.
**Formulas:** Loss = CP − SP | Loss% = (Loss ÷ CP) × 100.
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/59088e907697be474c93e7028816d475eda3da2866ae79ef704234ab2bc48265.png] 
⇒ Let **Cost Price (CP)** of 1 book be Re. 1.
⇒ **Cost Price** of 20 books = Rs. 20.
⇒ **Selling Price (SP)** of 20 books = **Cost Price** of 6 books = Rs. 6.
⇒ Loss = CP − SP = 20 − 6 = Rs. 14.
⇒ Loss % = (Loss ÷ CP) × 100 = (14 ÷ 20) × 100.
⇒ Loss % = 7 × 10 = 70%.

**∴ The correct answer is 70% loss.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Loss and Gain Percent

Profit or Loss is always calculated on the **Cost Price** unless otherwise stated in the problem.

Ratio Method

If CP of 'a' articles = SP of 'b' articles, then Profit or Loss % = ((a − b) ÷ b) × 100. Positive result denotes Profit, negative denotes Loss.</p
